svg.aria-label: Moonsplit: Named after the Moon. It has phases. So do your flatmates' excuses. Rent doesn't. Splits flat rent and bills to the paisa. Every month has to add up to ₹0. Private beta. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma, PostgreSQL.
